synthetics.label: Synthetic journey failed
synthetics.detail: Critical user journey · three consecutive regions

discover-time-window.headline: Intermittent checkout degradation reported
discover-time-window.summary: Several checkout attempts appeared slow or failed, but the report arrived without a precise incident window.
discover-time-window.impact: Customer impact may have been brief. Normal traffic is visible before and after the suspected event, so the first priority is to establish when the degradation actually occurred.

signals.label: Customer signal
signals.value: Short-lived checkout failures reported

signals.label: Telemetry
signals.value: Normal and anomalous events share the current view

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Confirm the affected time window

http-error-regression.headline: Server-error rate breached the post-release guardrail
http-error-regression.summary: HTTP 5xx responses increased shortly after a production rollout. Aggregate service health is red, but the failing request path is not yet isolated.
http-error-regression.impact: A subset of customer API calls is failing. Release Engineering has paused further promotion while the on-call identifies the affected endpoint and a representative error.

signals.label: Rule
signals.value: 5xx ratio above 5% for 3 evaluation windows

signals.label: Change context
signals.value: Production rollout completed recently

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Find the failing endpoint and error signature

auth-rejection-surge.headline: Sign-in rejection rate is well above baseline
auth-rejection-surge.summary: Authentication failures are elevated across the sign-in path. Expected rejections are mixed with the anomalous responses, obscuring the actionable reason.
auth-rejection-surge.impact: Some customers cannot establish new sessions. Existing sessions remain healthy, so the incident is currently scoped to fresh authentication attempts.

signals.label: Anomaly
signals.value: Rejections running at more than 3× baseline

signals.label: Noise
signals.value: Normal policy denials are included in the total

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Isolate the abnormal rejection reason

deployment-version-regression.headline: One fleet cohort became unhealthy during rollout
deployment-version-regression.summary: Errors rose on only part of the service fleet after a rolling deployment. Aggregate health masks which cohort is behaving differently.
deployment-version-regression.impact: Requests are intermittently failing depending on the serving instance. The rollout is paused pending evidence that the new version is—or is not—the differentiator.

signals.label: Fleet health
signals.value: Mixed outcomes across otherwise identical instances

signals.label: Change context
signals.value: Rolling deployment still within the incident window

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Compare outcomes by service version

rare-error-signature.headline: Low-volume exception is driving failed requests
rare-error-signature.summary: A busy service is mostly healthy, but one uncommon exception appears to correlate with customer-facing failures.
rare-error-signature.impact: The overall error percentage remains small enough to hide in aggregate dashboards. Incident response needs the rare signature and one correlated request before escalating to the owning team.

signals.label: Error budget
signals.value: Fast burn detected despite high successful volume

signals.label: Cardinality
signals.value: Many routine messages, very few decisive exceptions

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Capture a signature and correlated request

schema-drift-data-quality.headline: Business-event dashboard count dropped unexpectedly
schema-drift-data-quality.summary: A key dashboard count fell while ingress traffic stayed flat, suggesting a telemetry contract problem rather than a real traffic loss.
schema-drift-data-quality.impact: Operational reporting and downstream analytics may be incomplete. Teams need to know which producer stopped populating the expected field before trusting the dashboard again.

signals.label: Dashboard
signals.value: Tracked event count materially below baseline

signals.label: Ingress
signals.value: Request volume remains within normal range

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Identify the producer and version with missing fields

log-pattern-noise-reduction.headline: Warning volume spiked alongside request failures
log-pattern-noise-reduction.summary: Thousands of repetitive warnings are flooding the service logs. Most are benign, and only one pattern appears connected to failed requests.
log-pattern-noise-reduction.impact: The on-call cannot use raw warning volume as a reliable incident signal. The actionable pattern must be separated from background noise before remediation begins.

signals.label: Log volume
signals.value: Warning throughput more than 10× normal

signals.label: Customer signal
signals.value: Failed requests increased in the same interval

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Find the pattern correlated with failure

esql-top-failing-routes.headline: Public API error budget is burning across several routes
esql-top-failing-routes.summary: Failed requests are elevated, but absolute error counts alone may overstate high-traffic endpoints and understate a smaller route with a worse failure rate.
esql-top-failing-routes.impact: Multiple customer journeys may be affected. Incident command needs a ranked route summary using both failure count and failure rate before assigning responders.

signals.label: SLO
signals.value: API availability burn rate above paging threshold

signals.label: Scope
signals.value: Several routes contributing to the alert

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Rank routes by volume and failure rate

esql-before-after-deploy.headline: Release health changed after production deployment
esql-before-after-deploy.summary: Latency and errors appear elevated after a recent release, but the deploy timeline and natural traffic variation make the visual trend inconclusive.
esql-before-after-deploy.impact: The rollout is paused at the current cohort. Release Engineering needs a quantified before/after comparison to decide whether to roll back or continue.

signals.label: Guardrail
signals.value: Latency and error checks outside normal tolerance

signals.label: Decision
signals.value: Rollback held pending quantitative evidence

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Compare pre- and post-deploy periods

esql-cross-service-summary.headline: Checkout incident spans multiple service boundaries
esql-cross-service-summary.summary: The active incident touches several services, and individual dashboards do not provide a comparable view of request volume, failures, and tail latency.
esql-cross-service-summary.impact: Response ownership is unclear. Incident command needs a compact cross-service health table to focus engineering attention on the strongest signal.

signals.label: Topology
signals.value: Multiple services present in affected requests

signals.label: Tail latency
signals.value: High-percentile duration above normal operating range

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Summarise volume, failures, and p95 by service

dashboard-incident-triage.headline: Regional service health alarm needs rapid triage
dashboard-incident-triage.summary: The service overview shows a concentrated production anomaly, but the alert payload does not identify the affected region, service, or exact interval.
dashboard-incident-triage.impact: Customer requests are degraded in at least one operating region. The incident commander needs a fast scope assessment before paging additional teams.

signals.label: Overview
signals.value: One concentrated anomaly in the current dashboard range

signals.label: Scope
signals.value: Region and service not yet confirmed

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Identify where and when impact occurred

dashboard-drilldown-to-evidence.headline: Dashboard spike requires document-level confirmation
dashboard-drilldown-to-evidence.summary: A sharp failure spike is visible in the service overview. Responders need to preserve its time and filter context while moving from the chart to raw evidence.
dashboard-drilldown-to-evidence.impact: The aggregate signal is credible but not yet actionable. A source event is required before the issue can be assigned to an engineering owner.

signals.label: Dashboard
signals.value: Short, high-amplitude failure spike

signals.label: Evidence gap
signals.value: No representative source document attached

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Drill down without losing incident context

dashboard-panel-inspection.headline: Conflicting dashboard panels are blocking triage
dashboard-panel-inspection.summary: Two panels describing service health appear to disagree. Their calculation and filter scopes must be inspected before either metric is used for an incident decision.
dashboard-panel-inspection.impact: Stakeholders are receiving contradictory status updates. The on-call must establish which panel answers the operational question and explain why.

signals.label: Dashboard
signals.value: Adjacent panels report different health states

signals.label: Risk
signals.value: Metric definitions may use different scopes

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Inspect calculations and filter context

slow-dependency-trace.headline: Checkout p95 latency breached the customer SLO
slow-dependency-trace.summary: Checkout requests are completing slowly across the production path. The entry service is healthy enough to respond, suggesting time is being spent deeper in the dependency chain.
slow-dependency-trace.impact: Customers are waiting several seconds at order confirmation and some are abandoning the flow. The on-call needs the downstream operation consuming the trace critical path.

signals.label: SLO
signals.value: Checkout p95 above 2.5 s for 3 windows

signals.label: Probe
signals.value: Order confirmation step consistently delayed

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Find the slow dependency and operation

trace-error-propagation.headline: Edge service is returning generic upstream failures
trace-error-propagation.summary: The public edge reports a generic error, but its own logs do not contain the originating exception. The failure must be followed through the distributed trace.
trace-error-propagation.impact: Customers see unsuccessful requests with no useful client-side explanation. Ownership cannot be assigned until the originating span and propagation path are established.

signals.label: Edge response
signals.value: Generic upstream failure returned to callers

signals.label: Trace state
signals.value: Error status propagates across service boundaries

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Locate the first exception in the trace

retry-amplification.headline: Dependency traffic rose without matching user demand
retry-amplification.summary: Downstream call volume and latency increased while incoming customer traffic remained comparatively steady, raising suspicion of retry amplification.
retry-amplification.impact: The dependency may be receiving several calls for one user request, increasing load and extending the critical path. Responders need trace-level proof before changing retry policy.

signals.label: Traffic ratio
signals.value: Dependency calls growing faster than entry requests

signals.label: Latency
signals.value: Repeated downstream time is accumulating

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Compare traces and prove repeated calls

trace-log-correlation.headline: Payment trace failed without exception context
trace-log-correlation.summary: A customer payment trace ends in failure, but the span metadata does not include the application error needed to diagnose it.
trace-log-correlation.impact: The payment attempt could not complete and first-line support lacks a useful error reason. The exact application log must be recovered using the trace and time context.

signals.label: Trace
signals.value: Failed payment request captured end to end

signals.label: Evidence gap
signals.value: Exception details absent from span metadata

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Find the correlated application log

cpu-saturation.headline: Service latency climbed during a traffic peak
cpu-saturation.summary: One production service slowed as request volume increased. CPU saturation is suspected, but temporal alignment with the latency event has not been confirmed.
cpu-saturation.impact: Customers are seeing slower responses under load. Capacity changes should wait until responders prove that compute pressure coincides with the incident.

signals.label: APM
signals.value: Service response time above normal range

signals.label: Load
signals.value: Traffic peak overlaps the suspected interval

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Correlate service latency with CPU usage

memory-leak-and-restarts.headline: Workload instability and restarts are increasing
memory-leak-and-restarts.summary: A long-running workload has become unstable over several hours. Recent restarts may be related to sustained memory growth rather than a single traffic spike.
memory-leak-and-restarts.impact: Requests can fail or be retried while instances recycle. The platform team needs the resource trend and first restart evidence before changing limits or rolling back.

signals.label: Workload
signals.value: Restart count above normal operating baseline

signals.label: Time horizon
signals.value: Degradation developed over several hours

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Connect the memory trend to the first restart

hot-instance-imbalance.headline: Fleet averages are hiding a hot instance
hot-instance-imbalance.summary: Aggregate service health looks acceptable, but one instance appears to be consuming disproportionate resources and responding more slowly than its peers.
hot-instance-imbalance.impact: Only requests routed to the outlier are degraded, making the issue intermittent. The instance must be identified and compared with healthy peers before replacement.

signals.label: Fleet average
signals.value: Within broad limits despite intermittent latency

signals.label: Distribution
signals.value: Instance-level resource use appears imbalanced

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Find the outlier and verify peer health

capacity-throughput-saturation.headline: Latency rises sharply above an unknown traffic threshold
capacity-throughput-saturation.summary: The service remains healthy at ordinary load but degrades during high-throughput periods. Responders need an evidence-based saturation point rather than a single peak reading.
capacity-throughput-saturation.impact: Peak demand is pushing customer latency outside the SLO. Capacity Engineering needs the approximate throughput knee to guide safe scaling and admission-control changes.

signals.label: SLO
signals.value: Tail latency breached only during high load

signals.label: Pattern
signals.value: Healthy and saturated periods both available

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Estimate the throughput saturation point

active-alert-triage.headline: Fulfilment customer-failure alert is active
active-alert-triage.summary: A new alert fired for an unfamiliar fulfilment service. Its reason suggests customer impact, but the alert state must be checked against current source events.
active-alert-triage.impact: Shipment requests may be unavailable. The incident should be escalated only if the condition is still active and production evidence supports the alert reason.

signals.label: Rule
signals.value: Fulfilment customer failures

signals.label: Evaluation
signals.value: Alert condition met in the latest window

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Classify priority and cite source evidence

slow-payments.headline: Checkout completion time breached the latency SLO
slow-payments.summary: Customers report that checkout has become slow in the last few minutes. The delay is visible at the edge, but the responsible service has not been identified.
slow-payments.impact: Some shoppers are waiting more than three seconds to place an order, increasing abandonment risk. The on-call needs correlated request evidence before paging a downstream owner.

signals.label: SLO
signals.value: Checkout p95 above 3 s for 3 windows

signals.label: Route
signals.value: POST /checkout · production

signals.label: Triage request
signals.value: Identify the bottleneck with trace evidence
